orgName: Premier Padel (Qatar Airways Premier Padel Tour)

source.name: Premier Padel - Premier Padel announces multi-year partnership with Qatar Airways
source.note: The tour is renamed the 'Qatar Airways Premier Padel Tour', Qatar Airways becomes 'Official Airline Partner', and the Barcelona finals become the 'Qatar Airways Premier Padel Finals'.

note: Multi-year tour title sponsor and airline partner since 2024. Owner (QSI) and title sponsor are both Qatari state entities.
